# GhosttyKit

OcHerdr uses the `manaflow-ai/ghostty` embedder APIs pinned at commit
`3da10da73ae848c0310e3e0f0cb29e509c2f6963`. The same commit is maintained on
the `ocherdr/ghosttykit` branch of <https://github.com/OcHub-team/ghostty>.

Run `scripts/bootstrap-ghosttykit.sh` to download and verify the matching
prebuilt `GhosttyKit.xcframework`. The generated framework is intentionally not
tracked by Git.
